decision.interpretation: Bold layout (boldRatio=1) on page 17. 'Điều 30...' stands alone at the top of block b268, naming and opening the substantive article provisions that follow immediately below.
Bold layout on page 17, block b277. 'Điều 31. Dịch vụ cấp dấu thời gian' operates as a standalone article heading introducing the definition and rules for timestamp services at this location.
Bold layout on page 17, block b283. 'Điều 32. Dịch vụ chứng thực thông điệp dữ liệu' functions as a genuine article heading opening the subsequent content, distinct from clause items or headers.
